title: 121 · Dub lights live code and ASCII

Zero source frames, images or source video loaded at runtime. Comparison export retains reference audio with attribution; audio is not independently recreated.
editable: Pure time editor choreography, displayed text, note/highlight beats and ASCII field mathematics in composition.js; dimensions, timing, BPM, glyph grid and palette in project.json.
fidelity: Dedicated full observed sequence implemented; exact original ASCII synthesis, character density, reactive music modulation, masks, font and phase are approximated. Reference audio is attributed and not regenerated. No pixel identity, realtime full AV watch or user aesthetic approval claimed.
